Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, glob, os
want={'CBLC','CBDT','EBLC','EBDT','bloc','bdat','sbix','COLR','CPAL','SVG '}
for p in glob.glob('font-corpus/*')+glob.glob('text-rendering-tests/fonts/*'):
 try:
  data=open(p,'rb').read(2048)
  if len(data)<12: continue
  sfnt=data[:4]
  if sfnt not in [b'\0\1\0\0',b'OTTO',b'ttcf',b'true',b'typ1']: continue
  if sfnt==b'ttcf':
   off=struct.unpack('>L',data[12:16])[0]
  else: off=0
  num=struct.unpack('>H',data[off+4:off+6])[0]
  tabs=[]
  full=open(p,'rb').read()
  for i in range(num):
   ent=full[off+12+16*i:off+28+16*i]
   if len(ent)<16: continue
   tag=ent[:4].decode('latin1')
   tabs.append(tag)
  inter=want&set(tabs)
  if inter:
   print(os.path.basename(p), sorted(inter), 'all', tabs)
 except Exception as e: pass
PY` executed with exit code 0.
